oven.lore.legendary: Baked a loaf so tall that it pushed the oven door open and peeked out to say hello.

teapot.lore.uncommon: Has a lid that rattles whenever the kettle boils, as if it is cheering it on.

vending_machine.lore.uncommon: Rejects the same coin five times in a row and then takes it without a fuss.

x_cereal.lore.rare: Lures every person in the house downstairs with the rattle of its box before the bowl is even out.

x_dish_rack.lore.legendary: Balanced a whole birthday party's plates in a tower so tall that the cat sat on top like a flag.

x_espresso_cup.lore.common: Comes on its own tiny saucer and looks like a cup made for a doll's tea party.

x_measuring_jug.lore.legendary: Measured the rain in the garden so carefully one summer that the weather forecaster rang to ask for its numbers.

x_milk_glass.lore.rare: Makes anyone who drinks a whole glass feel strong enough to carry the shopping in one trip.

x_oatmeal.lore.legendary: Was stirred so slowly and so well that a grandad said it tasted exactly like the one his gran made.

x_paella.lore.epic: Was shared out so slowly that the prawn on top got passed round the table four times and still nobody took it.
x_paella.lore.legendary: Was so good at a family reunion that three cousins who had argued for years sat down and shared the crispy bit.

x_sugar_bowl.lore.epic: Lost every sugar lump to a sneaky toddler at a tea party, and nobody's tea was sweet that day.
